stories.title: Rescue Efforts Resume in Nepal-Tibet Flood After Initial Halt Due to Lake Overflow
stories.summary: Rescue operations have resumed along the Nepal-Tibet border following a temporary halt caused by the risk of new flooding from an overflowing lake. The devastating floods, triggered by a glacial collapse, have resulted in at least 675 confirmed deaths in Nepal and seven in Tibet, with nearly 3,000 people reported missing. Emergency teams are racing to locate over 100 workers trapped in hydropower tunnels and to provide aid to the affected population, which includes 17,000 children in need of assistance.

This deal is described as 'historic' and aims to provide the U.S. access to vast untapped oil resources, potentially impacting gas prices.

stories.title: Russian Drone Strike Near Kyiv Kills Dozens and Forces Evacuations
stories.summary: A Russian drone strike on a weapons depot near Kyiv has resulted in at least 37 fatalities and prompted the evacuation of hundreds of residents. The attack, which occurred in a civilian area, caused significant damage to nearby residential buildings, including a care home. Ukrainian authorities have initiated an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the storage of munitions in such proximity to populated areas.

stories.title: Iceland Votes on Resuming EU Membership Negotiations in Referendum
stories.summary: Icelanders are voting in a referendum on whether to resume negotiations for European Union membership. The decision comes after a decade-long suspension of talks, which were halted in 2013 following a shift to a eurosceptic government. The outcome of this referendum is being closely monitored, given its potential implications for Iceland's future relationship with the EU.

Gunfire and explosions were heard across the capital, with clashes involving mutinous soldiers who reportedly held other soldiers hostage. The military junta, which came to power in a coup in 2023, stated that it is progressively retaking control of targeted sites.

stories.title: Nepal Flooding Sparks Concerns Over Climate Change Impact on Himalayan Glaciers
stories.summary: Recent flooding in Nepal has raised alarms among scientists regarding the accelerating impact of climate change on Himalayan glaciers. While some experts caution against attributing the disaster solely to human-induced climate change, others assert that it exemplifies the catastrophic events they have long predicted. In response to the disaster, India has increased its glacier monitoring efforts to better understand and mitigate the risks posed by rapidly melting glaciers.
